And a drummer was added -- he got out of Detroit Freddie Bryant from Detroit. But Freddie dropped out, but he did get to do a little work with Basie, I think, during the forties or so. Sometime or other, he was with Basie. But it was still the intact band from Toledo. Milt Senior's band.
Well, did you work with Papa Bouchet's band at the Villa DeNice?
